Thus we need to output the crime(s). Likely "过失致人死亡" is a crime. Also maybe "非法使用爆炸物". Which is more appropriate? The fact says he violated safety regulations, not necessarily illegal possession. He had explosives legally, but not authorized to conduct independent blasting. That is a violation of safety regulations, leading to death. That is negligence. So "过失致人死亡" is appropriate.
